description.value: Kebab on Fire is a halal Mediterranean grill that opened in 2024 on Victoria's main commercial strip, serving slow-cooked lamb, beef, and kebab wraps with house-made sauces. It positions itself as a modern, fast-casual take on traditional Mediterranean grilling, with an emphasis on fresh ingredients and generous portions. A touring cyclist riding Government Street will find it a convenient stop for a protein-rich meal with online ordering available.
